name: GUILDGRANT-realm-gold-left-out
note: The award would sit in the treasury and neither buy a hall nor come back out - the hall's buy and a realm withdrawal spend realm_gold alone (HALL-GOLD).

name: GUILDGRANT-the-kind-unnamed
note: The ledger would say a member put 1,600,000 in - the trigger names a move with no kind a deposit.

name: GUILDGRANT-the-moment-unstamped
note: The line would carry the last deposit's moment, or none at all - guild_ledger.at is NOT NULL and the award fails.

name: GUILDGRANT-the-cap-unasked
note: An award could take a treasury past the cap every deposit is held to.

name: GUILDGRANT-the-name-as-typed
note: name_key is folded; 'empire of tamriel' typed into the workflow would find no guild.

name: GUILDGRANT-the-gold-unchecked
note: '1e6' would award a million, and a hex or padded figure would award what nobody typed.

name: GUILDGRANT-zero-awarded
note: A run of 0 writes a ledger line of nothing.

name: GUILDGRANT-an-input-spliced-into-a-run-line
note: An input pasted into a run: line is a shell command whoever runs the workflow can type.

name: GUILDGRANT-a-missing-guild-passes
old:
if [ "$(echo "$rows" | jq -r 'length')" != "1" ]; then
            echo "::error::no guild is named
new:
if [ "$(echo "$rows" | jq -r 'length')" = "-1" ]; then
            echo "::error::no guild is named
note: A misspelled guild would read as a dry run with an empty summary, and a green run.

name: GUILDGRANT-an-award-that-changed-none-passes
old:
if [ "$(echo "$rows" | jq -r 'length')" != "1" ]; then
            echo "::error::the award changed no guild
new:
if [ "$(echo "$rows" | jq -r 'length')" = "-1" ]; then
            echo "::error::the award changed no guild
note: A green run would tell the operator the gold was awarded when nothing was written.

name: GUILDGRANT-the-award-on-a-dry-run
old:
- name: Award the gold
        if: env.APPLY == 'true'
note: The dry run would write the award.
